sources.title: Hong Kong Open: Lakshya Sen's title hat-trick bid ends, Satwik-Chirag also crash out
Liverpool frustrate Chelsea as Keating heroics leave WSL title race wide open

en.title: Hong Kong Open badminton: Sen ends hat-trick bid; Liverpool hold Chelsea in WSL draw
en.dek: Lakshya Sen loses semifinal; Liverpool and Chelsea share goalless draw
facts: Lakshya Sen lost to Anders Antonsen 21-13, 21-13 in Hong Kong Open men's singles semifinals
Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty were eliminated in men's doubles semifinals by a Malaysian pair
Liverpool Women and Chelsea Women played to a goalless draw in the WSL
Khiara Keating made seven saves for Liverpool Women against Chelsea Women
The result leaves Chelsea vulnerable at the top of the WSL, with Manchester City able to move top with victory over Tottenham
body: At the Hong Kong Open Super 500, India's Lakshya Sen was eliminated in the men's singles semifinals by Denmark's Anders Antonsen, losing 21-13, 21-13. Earlier, the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty were also knocked out by a Malaysian pair.

In the Women's Super League, Liverpool Women frustrated league leaders Chelsea Women with a goalless draw at BrewDog Stadium. Inspired goalkeeper Khiara Keating made seven saves, her highest tally in a single game this season, to keep Chelsea from breaking down a stubborn defensive display.
en.context: Lakshya Sen competed at the Hong Kong Open Super 500. Liverpool Women and Chelsea Women faced each other in a Barclays Women's Super League match.

body: Bei den Hong Kong Open Super 500 schied Indiens Lakshya Sen im Halbfinale des Herreneinzeles gegen Dänemarks Anders Antonsen aus und verlor mit 21-13, 21-13. Zuvor waren auch die Herrendoppel Satwiksairaj Rankireddy und Chirag Shetty durch ein malaysisches Duo ausgeschaltet worden.

In der Women's Super League trennte sich Liverpool Women mit einem torlosen Unentschieden von Tabellenführer Chelsea Women im BrewDog Stadium. Inspiriert von Torhüterin Khiara Keating, die sieben Paraden hielt – ihre höchste Zahl in einer Partie dieser Saison – verhinderte Chelsea ein Durchbrechen eines sturmen Defensivs.

body: À l'Open de Hong Kong Super 500, Lakshya Sen, de l'Inde, a été éliminé en demi-finale du simple hommes par le Danois Anders Antonsen, sur le score de 21-13, 21-13. Plus tôt, le duo masculin de Satwiksairaj Rankireddy et Chirag Shetty avait également été éliminé par une paire malaisienne.

En Women's Super League, les Liverpool Women ont frustré les Chelsea Women, leaders du championnat, par un match nul sans but au BrewDog Stadium. La gardienne inspirée Khiara Keating a réalisé sept arrêts, son meilleur total en un seul match cette saison, pour empêcher Chelsea de percer une défense obstinée.

body: En el Hong Kong Open Super 500, Lakshya Sen de India fue eliminado en las semifinales del masculino individual por Anders Antonsen de Dinamarca, perdiendo 21-13, 21-13. Anteriormente, la pareja masculina de dobles Satwiksairaj Rankireddy y Chirag Shetty también fueron eliminados por una pareja malaya.

En la Women's Super League, el Liverpool Femenino frustró al líder Chelsea Femenino con un empate sin goles en el BrewDog Stadium. La portera inspirada Khiara Keating realizó siete atajadas, su máximo registro en un solo partido esta temporada, para impedir que el Chelsea rompiera una exhibición defensiva obstinada.

body: No Open de Hong Kong Super 500, o indiano Lakshya Sen foi eliminado nas meias-finais do singular masculino pelo dinamarquês Anders Antonsen, perdendo por 21-13, 21-13. Mais cedo, a dupla masculina de Satwiksairaj Rankireddy e Chirag Shetty também foi eliminada por um par malásio.

Na Women's Super League, as mulheres do Liverpool frustraram as mulheres do Chelsea, líderes da competição, com um empate sem golos no BrewDog Stadium. A guardiã inspirada Khiara Keating fez sete defesas, o seu maior total numa única partida esta época, para impedir que o Chelsea quebrasse uma exibição defensiva obstinada.

problemsFixed: Fact: 'Liverpool Women held Chelsea Women to a goalless draw at the Hong Kong Open' is unsupported and conflates two separate events. Fact: 'The result leaves Chelsea vulnerable at the top of the WSL' is unsupported in the badminton source. Fact: 'Khiara Keating made seven saves for Liverpool Women against Chelsea Women' is correct but must be attributed to Sky Sports. Fact: 'Satwik and Chirag were eliminated in the men's doubles semifinals by a Malaysian pair' is correct but must not imply a single narrative across unrelated sports. Fact: Body paragraph 3 repeats the WSL result from paragraph 1. Fact: Context paragraph invents 'bidding for a third consecutive title' and 'entering unbeaten in 18 matches' without confirming exact phrasing from sources. Fact: 'Keating's performance was highlighted as crucial' is vague attribution. Fact: Headline uses 'and' to join two unrelated sports; must be two separate headlines or a single neutral statement. Fact: Opening paragraph repeats the same noun 'Lakshya Sen' that opened the previous paragraph context. Fact: 'valiant efforts' is evaluative language; sources use 'fought valiantly' but the guideline bans such adjectives in the output. Fact: 'Inspired goalkeeper' is atmospheric; must be neutral. Fact: No sentence in body adds new information beyond what was in the first two paragraphs.
